featured_reviews.name: Sajeed Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently purchased a Suzuki Access 125 Ride Connect TFT ABS from ARC Suzuki, Mahim. Overall, I had a very good experience with the showroom.

The staff was courteous and supportive throughout the purchase process. A special thanks to Vinayak, who was extremely helpful, patiently answered all our queries, and kept us regularly updated on the booking and delivery status. The test ride was also arranged without any hassle, which helped in making the decision.

The only downside was that the showroom's air conditioning was not working on the day of delivery, which was quite uncomfortable given the scorching Mumbai heat. Apart from that, everything else met our expectations.

I would definitely recommend ARC Suzuki, Mahim, to anyone looking to purchase a Suzuki two-wheeler.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Devgharkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been servicing my Suzuki Access 125 at this service centre for the last five years. Unfortunately, my recent experience was highly disappointing.
At the time of handing over my vehicle for servicing, I was provided with an estimated cost of approximately ₹6,800. However, I was never informed that labour charges of such a substantial amount would be added to the bill. While approval for the work was obtained, no clarity whatsoever was given regarding the labour charges that would be levied.
To my shock, the final bill came to around ₹12,000 even after discounts. The labour charges alone were nearly equal to the cost of the parts and other service items. Such exorbitant labour charges are unreasonable and create an impression that the entire service centre was engaged in working on a single vehicle.
When I questioned these charges at the billing desk, no satisfactory explanation or detailed justification was provided. The staff simply failed to address a legitimate concern regarding the basis of the labour charges. Transparency in billing is a basic expectation, especially from an authorized service centre.
I was also expecting benefits under my AMC membership, but no meaningful advantage was evident. Further, the discount reflected in the bill appears to be more of a formality to show that some concession was granted rather than a genuine attempt to address the issue of excessive labour charges.
As a customer who has trusted this service centre for the last five years, I feel let down by the lack of transparency and poor customer communication. Customers should be clearly informed in advance about major labour costs and should not be surprised with inflated bills at the time of payment.
Very disappointed with the billing practices and the inability of the staff to justify the charges imposed.

featured_reviews.name: Upendra singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here's my honest take.

The guys here are knowledgeable, hard working and perform what they say to the perfection. No cutting corners.

My bike (a vstrom 650 xt) was having issues of stalling when overheating. Could ride only about 17 to 20 kms max and on a good day about 25 kms.

The issue though was pointed out to me by fellow rider as root cause, the work they have done to resolve that issue was superfluous.

In addition to changing the fuel filter which was the issue, these guys worked on my fuel drain (outlet for gas built up in tank).

Side stand sensor was checked and found to be with cut wires by them and was resolved as it was contributing to stalling of the bike.

The brake servicing was done nicely that the hardwork these people was outstanding. Before this visit I never knew that this is how much can be done behind brake pads, brake caplipers and cylinders. I believe me I have seen many authorised as well as 3rd party service centers which don't do anything at all.

Chain cleaning for other service centers is just a couple of sprays here and there against which they charge you the same amount as that of entire cans of cleaner and lube. But for these guys it was scrubbing, cleaning, lubricating, chain alignment and much more of such things to make sure the chain looks like new.

I would say say that they are charging on the lower side but what they have charged me is worth every penny and is the best money I have spent in my 14 years of riding.
